purpose: calibration by configuration and agreement stratum; RQ2's pre-registered calibration endpoint

config_labels.C1: C1 hard majority label, extended cohort
config_labels.C3: C3 hard label + matched label smoothing (control)

primary_target: expected accuracy under the 4-annotator vote distribution

RQ2_calibration.rule: BETTER CALIBRATED if the paired CI of ECE(C2) - ECE(C3) on the pooled contested set excludes 0 below zero.
